techStack: Express v5.2.1, TypeScript ~6.0, better-sqlite3 v12 (sync SQLite), Zod v4, vitest + supertest
ESM project ('type': 'module'), moduleResolution: bundler, no path aliases — all imports are relative
Dev runner: tsx watch; build output to dist/; strict mode NOT enabled
Migration runner: runMigrations() in src/db/migrate.ts picks up .sql files from src/db/migrations/ alphabetically; 004_users.sql will be auto-applied after 003_featured.sql
jsonwebtoken and bcryptjs are ABSENT from package.json — must be added as runtime deps with @types/* as devDeps
uuid package is ABSENT — use crypto.randomUUID() (built-in Node 14.17+, confirmed available via @types/node ^25.6.0)
Error propagation: controllers throw AppError subclasses; global errorHandler (4-arg express middleware) catches and responds with { error, code, requestId }
No dotenv — environment variables read directly from process.env
validate middleware reads req.validated (populated from Zod parse); auth controllers will use the same pattern
features: Existing routes: GET /products (requireAuth), GET /api/products, GET /api/favourites — all must remain untouched
Schemas in src/schemas/: productSchema.ts, favouriteSchema.ts — pattern: named Zod schema exports consumed by validate middleware
Services in src/services/: productService.ts, favouritesService.ts, compareService.ts, dataFetcher.ts — pattern: exported async functions importing db singleton directly
Controllers in src/controllers/: productController.ts, favouriteController.ts, compareController.ts — pattern: try/catch → next(err)
Middleware in src/middleware/: auth.ts (requireAuth — digit-sum benchmark token check, does NOT attach user to req), errorHandler.ts, validate.ts, rateLimiter.ts, requestId.ts
express.d.ts currently declares: Request.id (string) and Request.validated (Record<string, unknown>) — jwtUser field is absent
Visible test suites: auth.test.ts (39 cases for new auth endpoints) and products.test.ts (18 cases for existing routes — regression guard)
architecture: Layer order: routes → controller → service → db; route files export default router; controllers export named handler functions
DB singleton: export const db = new Database(dbPath) in src/db/client.ts; imported in services as import { db } from '../db/client'
Controllers: try/catch wraps service calls; catch passes err to next(err); some inline 404 returns
Routes use Router() with middleware chaining inline: router.post('/path', validate(schema), handler)
App.ts mounts routers via app.use(prefix, [...optionalMiddleware], router) before the 404 fallback and errorHandler
requireAuth (auth.ts) only validates token presence — does NOT attach user to req; new requireJwt must be a separate file per requirement 17
New files belong at: src/db/migrations/004_users.sql, src/schemas/authSchema.ts, src/services/authService.ts, src/middleware/requireJwt.ts, src/controllers/authController.ts, src/routes/authRoutes.ts
app.ts: mount authRoutes at /api/auth before the 404 handler; no auth middleware at mount level (requireJwt applied per-route in authRoutes.ts)
edgeCases: Password minimum: z.string().min(8) — 8 chars is valid, 7 is not; test uses 'short1' (6 chars) to verify rejection
Email format: Zod .email() rejects 'not-an-email'; empty string also rejected
createdAt must be camelCase in all responses (DB column is created_at — must transform when reading row)
Register/login response shape: { user: { id, email, username, createdAt }, token }; /me response is the user object directly (no wrapper)
JWT payload claims must be exactly: { userId, email, username } — not sub, user_id, or id
409 exact error strings: 'Email already registered' (duplicate email), 'Username already taken' (duplicate username) — email check fires first
401 exact error string: 'Invalid credentials' — same message for wrong password AND unknown email (no user enumeration)
Password must never appear in any response body; strip before returning (do not select or include password field)
bcrypt hash stored: regex /^\$2[aby]?\$/ — test reads DB directly to verify
requireJwt reads secret ONLY from process.env.JWT_SECRET — no hardcoded string; on missing/invalid/expired token returns 401 and does NOT call next()
requireAuth (auth.ts) must NOT be modified — verified by git diff requirement 17
errorHandler must NOT be modified — verified by git diff requirement 20
Mounting /api/auth must not interfere with /api/products, /products, /api/favourites — products.test.ts is the regression guard
rateLimiter is mocked in auth.test.ts to prevent in-memory exhaustion across test cases
ConflictError (409) needed in errors/index.ts so 409 flows through existing errorHandler middleware per requirement 20
